definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the exact inner-loop body AST; it introduces a named proof term rather than an additional mathematical fact or execution rule.
definitions.text:
rule innerBody =>
    If(Compare(BinOp("%", Name("candidate"), Name("divisor")),
               CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
       Assign(Name("prime"), Bool(false)) .Stmts,
       .Stmts)
    Assign(Name("divisor"),
           BinOp("+", Name("divisor"), Int(1))) .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the exact outer-loop body AST from assignments, the inner loop, append, and candidate increment.
definitions.text:
rule outerBody =>
    Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
    Assign(Name("prime"), Bool(true))
    While(Compare(Name("divisor"), CmpOp("<", Name("candidate"))),
          innerBody)
    If(Name("prime"),
       Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("primes"), "append"),
                 Name("candidate"))) .Stmts,
       .Stmts)
    Assign(Name("candidate"),
           BinOp("+", Name("candidate"), Int(1))) .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the exact count_up_to function-body proof term used by the target claim.
definitions.text:
rule countBody =>
    If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("<=", Int(2))),
       Return(ListExpr(.Exprs)) .Stmts,
       .Stmts)
    Assign(Name("primes"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
    Assign(Name("candidate"), Int(2))
    Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
    Assign(Name("prime"), Bool(true))
    While(Compare(Name("candidate"), CmpOp("<", Name("n"))),
          outerBody)
    Return(Name("primes")) .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Validation-only macro expansion defining the start-at-3 mutated function body; it is still a named AST definition, not an operational model rule.
definitions.text:
rule countBodyStart3 =>
    If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("<=", Int(2))),
       Return(ListExpr(.Exprs)) .Stmts,
       .Stmts)
    Assign(Name("primes"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
    Assign(Name("candidate"), Int(3))
    Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
    Assign(Name("prime"), Bool(true))
    While(Compare(Name("candidate"), CmpOp("<", Name("n"))),
          outerBody)
    Return(Name("primes")) .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Totalization equation for the noDivisors summary, normalizing divisor starts below 2 to the summary's lower bound.
definitions.text:
rule noDivisors(N, D) => noDivisors(N, 2)
    requires D <Int 2

definitions.rationale: Base equation of noDivisors: the divisor-search interval is empty once D is at least N.
definitions.text:
rule noDivisors(N, D) => true
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool D >=Int N

definitions.rationale: Defining false case of noDivisors when the current in-range divisor divides N.
definitions.text:
rule noDivisors(N, D) => false
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool D <Int N
     andBool pyMod(N, D) ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Recursive defining equation of noDivisors that advances past a non-dividing candidate.
definitions.text:
rule noDivisors(N, D) => noDivisors(N, D +Int 1)
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool D <Int N
     andBool pyMod(N, D) =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining primesBetween as empty when the candidate has reached or passed the upper bound.
definitions.text:
rule primesBetween(C, N) => .ValSeq
    requires C >=Int N

definitions.rationale: Recursive defining equation that skips candidates below the minimum prime value 2.
definitions.text:
rule primesBetween(C, N)
    => primesBetween(C +Int 1, N)
    requires C <Int N andBool C <Int 2

definitions.rationale: Recursive defining equation that includes an in-range candidate when the noDivisors summary classifies it as prime.
definitions.text:
rule primesBetween(C, N)
    => vCons(C, primesBetween(C +Int 1, N))
    requires C <Int N andBool C >=Int 2
     andBool noDivisors(C, 2)

definitions.rationale: Recursive defining equation that skips an in-range candidate when noDivisors is false.
definitions.text:
rule primesBetween(C, N)
    => primesBetween(C +Int 1, N)
    requires C <Int N andBool C >=Int 2
     andBool notBool noDivisors(C, 2)

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining primesBelow as the empty sequence for upper bounds at most 2.
Defining equation reducing primesBelow above 2 to the primesBetween summary beginning at 2.
definitions.text:
rule primesBelow(N) => primesBetween(2, N)
    requires N >Int 2

source_rules.rationale: Associativity of the pre-existing valSeqConcat operation is an additional simplification fact; Stage 1 compiles this rule before kprove and contains no separate proof of its exact statement in a module omitting the rule.
source_rules.text:
rule valSeqConcat(valSeqConcat(A:ValSeq, B:ValSeq), C:ValSeq)
    => valSeqConcat(A, valSeqConcat(B, C))
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Right identity of the pre-existing valSeqConcat operation is an additional simplification fact; Stage 1 compiles this rule before kprove and contains no separate proof of its exact statement in a module omitting the rule.
